card.title: IPhone 6 boots to Apple logo and turns back off fix

source.title: IPhone 6 boots to Apple logo and turns back off fix

symptoms: Apple logo then turns off after ~2 minutes

claims.statement: An iPhone 6 that shows the logo for about 2 min 10 s then shuts off (not looping), and only appears in DFU with serial NA, can be recovered by holding Home on the charger until recovery mode appears (may take minutes) and then restoring/updating.

procedure: Hold Home until the recovery screen appears.
card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
